summary_responses.response: The National Credit Union Administration (NCUA) finalized a rule amending its criteria for recognizing associational common bonds for federal credit unions. summary_responses.subtopic: Federal Electronic Payment Systems Modernization & Digital Fee Infrastructure
summary_responses.response: The FAA proposes to require electronic payments only for all fees and penalties under 14 CFR parts 13, 47, 49, 61, 63, 65, 187, and 406, eliminating cash, money orders, and paper checks. The rule is expected to save FAA approximately $99,815 annually and $1.4 million perpetually, with minimal customer impact during transition. Comments are due by January 4, 2027.

summary_responses.subtopic: National Park Administration, Conservation & Multi-Use Trail Regulation
summary_responses.response: The National Park Service finalized a rule amending special regulations for Mammoth Cave National Park to allow bicycle use on approximately 37 miles of multi-use trails and permit horseback riding on the 5.4-mile Houchin Ferry North/Ollie Road. The rule removes bicycle access from two existing trails (the Maple Springs Connector Trail and the White Oak Trail) and designates eight new trails for bicycle use to achieve the ~37-mile total. It adds a new paragraph permitting equestrian use on Houchin Ferry North/Ollie Road, overriding the general NPS rule that normally prohibits horses on park roads. Electric bicycles are allowed on trails open to traditional bicycles under existing NPS regulations (36 CFR 4.30(i)). The rule requires the superintendent to publicly notify visitors of designated trails through standard methods (e.g., maps, the Superintendent's Compendium). The rule becomes effective on December 21, 2026.
